name: Native
long_description: Native is the proactive marketing assistant for small businesses, based in San Francisco and Oslo. Our AI creates and posts their social media and ads, writes their newsletters and blog posts and builds their websites, all with no prompting. Since launching in March 2026 we have gone from $0 to about $2M ARR with 2,200+ paying businesses in 20+ countries, and we are profitable with a team of six. More than 500,000 posts have been made on Native, which shows us which ideas owners choose and how they perform. Founders Benjamin Bekken (ex-YouTuber with millions of views & double MSc in communication tech), Håkon Græsberg (MSc in AI) and Trond Haugå (founded a marketing agency at 18) have built marketing software together for almost four years. We are backed by Y Combinator (F26), Orange and the Andreessen Horowitz Scout Fund, with angels from Anthropic, Cognite and reMarkable. https://native.no/
